title: Trail Work Thursdays
description: Be a part of the community effort to maintain the trails in Van Cortlandt Park. Whether you’re an experienced trailblazer or new to trail maintenance, your help will make a significant impact!Meeting Details:Location: VCPA Learning Garden - 6000 Mosholu Ave, Bronx, NY 10471. Across from the Riverdale Stables.Time: 9 am sharp; work begins at 9:15 am.Upcoming Activities Include:Clearing debris and overgrowthEnsuring trail safety and accessibilityDesire line closuresWhat to Bring:Comfortable, weather-appropriate clothingClosed-toed shoesWater and a snackWhy Join Us?Contribute to the vitality and safety of the trails you love! Engage with fellow community members, learn about trail maintenance, and enjoy the satisfaction of hands-on work in the great outdoors.Necessary tools and gloves will be provided!Want to bring a group? This event is limited to small groups of 5 or less. If you would like to bring more 6 or more people, please reach out to stewardship@vancortlandt.org to schedule a separate event.
location: VCPA Learning Garden (in Van Cortlandt Park)
categories: Nature | Fitness | Volunteer | It's My Park | Outdoor Fitness | Hiking | Wildlife | Walking

title: Gardening Thursday at Fort Knox
description: We will be stewarding a rain garden at Fort Knox.Please wear clothing appropriate for outdoor weather and gardening/cleaning activities. We also recommend bringing snacks and a refillable water bottle to stay hydrated.All gloves and tools needed will be provided by the Alliance.
location: 3420 Duncomb Ave, Bronx, NY (in Bronx Park)

title: Volunteering at Conference House Park - The Blue Wave
description: Join NYC Parks and the Conference House Park Conservancy for our ongoing beach and park clean-up initiative!Pick up a trash grabber and a bucket and help to beautify our park by picking up litter and debris!Stop by the park Visitor's Center at 298 Satterlee Street, corner of Hylan Boulevard, Staten Island, NY, to meet our staff and borrow a bucket and grabber!Drop-ins welcome. No RSVP required. Blue Wave clean-ups are self-led by the volunteer stewards themselves. For group volunteer opportunities and volunteering at additional Staten Island South Shore sites, please contact the South Shore Parks Programs and Events Manager at 646-406-2155, or carmine.raimondi@parks.nyc.gov.
location: Conference House Museum (in Conference House Park)
categories: Nature | Volunteer | Waterfront | Wildlife | Walking | Gardening

title: Forest Fridays: Volunteer Forest Restoration at Van Cortlandt Park
description: Join the Van Cortlandt Park Alliance for forest restoration along the southern section of the Old Croton Aqueduct Trail. We remove invasive bush honeysuckle and multiflora rose by hand so native trees, shrubs and wildflowers can come back.Dates include Fridays weekly from October 2nd - October 30th. Dates are 10/2, 10/9, 10/16, 10/23, and 10/30.Meeting Details:Location: Classic Playground, Van Cortlandt Park South and Gouverneur Avenue. Meet at the public restroom building inside the playground.Time: 9:00 am - 12:00 pm.What to Bring:Long sleeves, long pants and sturdy closed-toed shoesWater and a snackTools, gloves and guidance provided; no experience needed. Ages 15+ (minors need a signed waiver). Limited to 30 volunteers per session. Groups of 6 or more, please email noel@vancortlandt.org first.
registration_description: Free. Please sign up for the specific date on Bloomerang Volunteer.
location: Van Cortlandt Classic Playground (in Van Cortlandt Park)

title: Restoration Fridays at Forest Park
description: Join NYC Parks and The Forest Park Trust for Forest Restoration Fridays this fall to engage in hands-on forest restoration work, including invasive species removal, trail restoration, and possible planting in our park.Registration is required. All tools will be provided, and no prior experience is needed. Just bring your enthusiasm. Please come dressed in sturdy, closed-toe shoes and bring your own water bottle.
